Veterinary care that Rises Above Every Expectation.
We're an independently owned practice where your pet's health is our personal mission.
Our newly built hospital is designed to set a new standard in specialty vet care. We recruited the most talented and caring veterinary professionals, provided them with cutting-edge diagnostic and clinical equipment, and the time to treat each pet as if they were their own. Then, we created the pet experience - from check-in to treatment - to foster a calm, healing environment. All this so we can give the pets you love the care they deserve.
Call to Book an Appointment
Get to Know the Rise Team
The Rise Difference
Expert
Our model has attracted some of SoCal's most distinctive ER doctors and board-certified specialists. Our talented team works collaboratively - within and across departments - to deliver exceptional care for your pet. You'll have the full expertise of our team behind you at every visit.
Caring
We don't overschedule our appointments, so we have time with you. And we pride ourselves on transparent and detailed communication.
Advanced
Having the most state-of-the-art equipment is essential - because getting the right diagnosis cannot happen without the most advanced tools. And frankly, our pets deserve that.
Calming
Going to the hospital is stressful. We married science with great design to create an aesthetic environment and patient care process that keeps your pet calm and avoids the trauma of the typical vet experience.
"This place is amazing!!! The absolute best experience that I have ever had at a vet hospital. We received honest, patient-focused care. All of the staff were incredibly caring and compassionate."
- Mollie J., Rise Client
Our Veterinary Specialties
Rise brings together some of the best board-certified veterinarians from all disciplines to work cooperatively under one roof and deliver superior outcomes. This collaboration among our doctors ensures that the greatest minds are working together to care for your pet.
24/7 Emergency Care
Licensed emergency vets are available 24/7 to care for your pet in the event of an unexpected medical emergency.
- Learn More
Critical Care
If your pet needs lifesaving critical care, our board-certified criticalists will devote every resource to helping them make a complete recovery.
Internal Medicine
Our boarded internists are specially trained to diagnose and treat more complex internal diseases such as diabetes, severe GI disease, kidney disease, UTIs and more.
Acupuncture and Chiropractic
Our integrative veterinarian specializes in acupuncture and chiropractic treatments as well as Chinese herbal remedies to enhance your pet's quality of life.
Integrative Medicine
Our integrative medicine approach combines trusted veterinary care with complementary therapies to ease pain, improve movement, and enhance overall wellness.
- Learn More
Pet Neurology
Our uniquely equipped veterinary neurology team in Laguna Hills treats conditions such as spinal cord disorders and seizures. We'll support you and your pet through every step of their treatment.
- Learn More
Oncology
Rise gives hope to pets and pet parents following a cancer diagnosis. We offer a variety of advanced tests and
cutting-edge
therapies to give your pet the best quality of life possible.
- Learn More
Surgery
Our skilled surgery team performs a broad range of complex soft-tissue and orthopedic procedures with constant, advanced monitoring and aggressive pain management.
- Learn More
Imaging
Our highly acclaimed imaging team can find answers to pressing questions about your pet's health with the aid of X-ray, Ultrasound, MRI, CT and Fluoroscopy.
